planets.name: TOI-712 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-712 with a 51.7-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-712 c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-712. Its orbit and size follow Vach et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
